game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · History/classification review
game_concept: A strategy race set in Sand Dunes – Dune Crest, a high dune crest: the desert nomad must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Edge Case Hunter: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dune Crest: a high dune crest
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
player_objective: Case 4: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about History/classification review.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Edge Case Hunter' (Week 9 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Dune Crest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.

source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the oasis by solving code steps involving edge_cases that move the desert nomad forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the oasis first, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Edge Case Hunter – Dune Crest Race
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
